exact_next_repair: Keep all 28 observations in the accounting. Split semantic navigation from other outside-tabpanel controls: direct tabs require button[role=tab][title][aria-controls]; a tablist is a structural container; other header or guest actions remain classified and mapped to existing control IDs where proven, not clicked as tabs.

Settings expanders require the active Settings panel, button[aria-expanded][aria-controls], and source-confirmed section identity. Classify the fingerprint-only button separately; do not open it or claim a missing section until its element provenance is known.

Add privacy-safe provenance to a guarded observation: scope, DOM order, tag, role, stable source-owned data-census-id or component/control anchor, ancestor region/section ID, and only allowlisted static aria-label/title/placeholder. Never collect values, user text, page content, tokens, or a reusable HMAC key. This is enough to distinguish anonymous inputs/buttons without clicking them.

Map the source-confirmed Settings controls to existing C02, C04, C05, C29, C15 and C16 only after provenance ties each observed node to its source anchor; map Chat controls similarly against existing EXT-F-2013 IDs. Add an inventory ID only if a provenance-identified source control has no existing coverage; none is demonstrated by this receipt.

Re-run the existing guarded guest census on an exact receipt-bound artifact and require zero unclassified observations and zero genuinely inaccessible regions, while retaining all action controls in counts and never clicking them. Independently review the new receipt before changing guest inventory status. Member/admin and current-main visibility remain unverified.
